item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:45 HKT 23/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will improve and it will be hot over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. Tropical Cyclone Mawar now over the western North Pacific is expected to move towards the seas east of the Philippines in the latter part of this week. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, it will be very hot over Guangdong early next week.
